about: Trimmed raw copy of the Slayer DB tables and slayer varbits for the plugin tests. SlayerTaskSublist is the boss list a boss task's SLAYER_TARGET_BOSSID is looked up in. Values are flat tuple arrays per column, as the client stores them. masterNpcs are the multi-NPCs that turn into a slayer master, with the raw transform list (the last entry is the default), masterNames the NPCs among them that give tasks, and quests the end states of the quests that move masters. enums are the reward shop's Buy tab: 840 slot to item, 841 item to amount, 842 item to cost in points. Made by tools/cache-dump with --fixture. Do not edit by hand.
